newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's PM says best weapon gainst mob is economy.
newsitem.headline: Italy's PM says best weapon gainst mob is economy.

text.p: VIGNOLA, Italy, July 21 - Prime Minister Romano Prodi, under pressure to combat an outbreak of gangland killings, has said Italy's war against organised crime can only be won by boosting the economy and providing employment.

Prodi's comments late on Sunday came after a weekend which saw five people murdered in and around the southern port city of Naples, in the latest episode of mob violence that has swept the area since the start of the year.
On Sunday a man was shot dead as he strolled down the street in broad daylight, bringing the death toll to 89 in the last six months.

"If we think the fight against the mob is only a fight against crime, then we have lost from the start. We can win only by giving people, young and old, the hope they have lost," Prodi said at the end of a conference on organised crime.
"Economic action will forever be more important," Prodi said, adding that organised crime was not only a problem in Italy, but an international scourge.

The government last week sent some 500 troops to Naples to help quell the violence which has erupted as rival clans of the Camorra, the Naples Mafia, have waged their bloody battles for supremacy in and around Naples and nearby Caserta.
Residents and local officials welcomed the army but warned the Camorra's success is tied to rampant unemployment. Naples has a jobless rate of almost 25 percent.
"Maybe it is true that the government has not done enough for employment," Prodi told reporters after the conference.
The army's presence has not yet quelled the violence. Since the soldiers arrival, nine people have been murdered.
Interior Minister Giorgio Napolitano told reporters the crime problem in the area "has become critical" and that the government would take extra measures to counter the problem. He did not elaborate.
The government has said the troops, which have taken up guard duties so that local police can focus on fighting the mob, will stay until the end of the year.
